description: This file contains core classes and utilities for reading binary data in the Orleans serialization library. It defines abstract interfaces for input streams, concrete implementations for stream-based input, and a versatile generic Reader struct for parsing various buffer types including spans, sequences, and streams. The code includes methods for reading primitive types, variable-length integers, and managing buffer positions and forks, all essential for efficient binary serialization/deserialization within Orleans.

classes.name: ReaderInput
classes.description: Abstract interface for binary input streams, providing methods for position management and reading various data types.

classes.name: StreamReaderInput
classes.description: Concrete implementation of ReaderInput that reads data from a Stream, managing buffer fills and seeking.

methods.name: Reader.Create
methods.description: Factory methods for creating a generic Reader instance with different buffer sources: pooled buffer, buffer slice, stream, ReadOnlySequence, or span/memory buffers.
